evidence.title: The Honda V4 Flagship Killed By A Tariff And A Rulebook Before Launch
evidence.body: [e003:f01] From there he started writing about motorsports, and has articles published on Autosport, , Sporting News, Motor1, The Autopian and more. [e003:f02] Sign in to your HotCars account Gear-driven cam whine, genuine technological innovations, and the fastest speeds available on a road bike at the time all sound like the recipe for a genre-defining superbike. [e003:f03] It meant that the bike launched into a world that didn’t exist when it first picked up the pen, and it suffered because of it. [e003:f04] Every year the benchmark was raised, as the battle for the fastest and most powerful bike hadn’t yet been curtailed by threats of government intervention as it would with 1999’s Suzuki Hayabusa. [e003:f05] Tariffs And Racing Rules Changed The Superbike Arms Race Overnight Suzuki Katana DriveTribe/YouTube Governments and racing organizations were rewriting rules as quickly as manufacturers could make bikes that contravened them, particularly in 1983, when the US government imposed a 45% tariff on imported motorcycles with engines larger than 700 cc. [e003:f06] Intended to help Harley-Davidson recover from growing competition, the measure dramatically increased the cost of large-displacement Japanese motorcycles entering the US market Although the tariff was scheduled to decline each year before expiring five years later, it effectively shifted the market toward 700 cc models during its lifetime. [e003:f07] With the import tariff in place, Japanese superbikes like the Suzuki GS1100E and GSX1000S Katana , Kawasaki's GPZ1100 , and even Honda's CB900F were suddenly far less economical options for those wanting performance. [e003:f08] The 1,000 cc classes that Honda in particular favored — things like TT-F1, and, in the US, the AMA Superbike Championship — were increasingly moving toward a 750 cc format, reducing the need for the big 1,000 cc homologation bikes that Honda was used to creating. [e003:f09] Honda’s VF1000R Was Already Fighting A Battle It Couldn’t Win 1985 Honda VF1000R Bring a Trailer When it was first introduced in 1984, the VF1000R was set to be Honda's flagship V4. [e003:f10] With the VF1000R intended to be Honda's most technologically advanced V4, Honda did away with the usual cam chains and instead opted for gear-driven camshafts taken directly from its 1982 AMA Formula 1 Championship-winning FWS1000 works endurance racer. [e003:f11] Honda VF1000R Square Headlight Mecum The bike was released in 1984, but only in Europe; Americans had to wait an extra two years to get their hands on the bike and, by the time they did, it had undergone some changes. [e003:f12] The engine's output was lower, for one, coming in at 117 horsepower compared to between 122 and 130 hp in Europe, the change being due to emissions regulations implemented by the EPA and the Department of Transportation. [e003:f13] Yamaha's FJ1100 weighed 556 lbs wet despite offering 10% more displacement, while the Suzuki GSX-R1100 was 554 lbs wet and offered an extra ~100 cc. [e003:f14] Honda carried what it learned with the VF1000R forwards into its VFR750R RC30 , which became one of the most celebrated race replicas ever produced as the race version of the bike won the first two World Superbike seasons in 1988 and 1989. [e003:f15] The technology also carried forward through Honda's V4 lineup, including the VFR750F and later VFR models, while the exotic NR demonstrated Honda's continued willingness to pursue unconventional engineering. [e003:f16] The bike took over as Honda’s flagship V4 and created a far greater legacy for innovation than the VF1000R ever had, proving that while it didn’t work in 1984, it would work one day.

evidence.title: 一机在手天下全有，本田自动挡750系列更新，不是老头乐而是王炸
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 有一个公认的观点是发动机专属性太高无法均摊成本，但这种说法在本田这里好像不奏效，它早已经实现了一机多用，并且还是跨界应用。 [e007:f02] 7月28日，本田摩托向欧洲市场发布了2027款750系列，它们分别是跨骑休旅车NC750X、跨界踏板X-ADV、运动大绵羊Forza750。 [e007:f03] 以上三款车型的更新仅针对表面涂装，不涉及核心硬件和配置组合，这种操作在本田的序列产品中极其常见，尤其是成熟款车型早已有之，逢年就会换装发布。 [e007:f04] 这三款看似没有联系的车型，因共用了NC动力平台，通常都会一起出现，所以我愿将其称之为自动挡750系列。 [e007:f05] 该系列车型的一大共性就是自动挡，且是10万级别为数不多采用DCT双离合变速箱的摩托车。 [e007:f06] 2008年前后本田产生了打造一台极致省油、容易上手，且能兼顾多用途，中量级摩托车动力平台的想法，随后依托汽车引擎的构造完成了模型机的测试与验证（据说参考对象是飞度）。 [e007:f07] 2011年米兰车展，本田展出了NC700S、NC700X、NC700D三台原型车，并面向全球公布了最新双缸动力平台，一年之后这三款车型正式投产上市。 [e007:f08] 2014年本田对NC平台进行了持续的优化和升级，将发动机排量提升至了745cc，并沿用至今。 [e007:f09] 这款发动机除了采用DCT双离合变速箱，还有270度曲轴、62度气缸倾斜设计，进而造就了其低重心、低油耗、宽泛动力的特点。 [e007:f10] 随着NC系列跨骑车的大获成功，本田并未止步于此，而是对这款别具一格的动力总成进行了扩充应用，将其完美复制到了踏板X-ADV和佛沙750，至此实现了“一机在手天下全有”的终极目标。 [e007:f11] 而佛沙750相较于X-ADV或许会逊色一点，但它的颜值、性能在同类车型中也是数一数二，如这款车的百公里油耗也是极低仅为3.54升，且排量还要比竞品大很多。 [e007:f12] 总之，本田依托NC动力平台所打造的750系列，并非老头乐那么简单，反而在技术应用和车型表现方面属于同级王炸，目前相对被动的也就是NSS750，而另外两款车型完全可以高枕无忧，这应该就是核心技术加持下的先天优势。 [e007:f13] 文章标签 点赞 评论 收藏 分享 举报/纠错 本文作者 骑士分享 4949 关注 · 4411 作品 关注 虽然业余，但很努力 作者其他作品 进入主页 铃木太子GL155，狂降5000折扣价不到万元，外观有个性性能也不错 6小时前 3999元起，雅迪摩登光芒II上线，外观有点小酷，有多个版本可选！ [e007:f14] 前天 09:04 热门内容 今日 本周 换一换 09:35 一箱油从苏杭到塞外！ [e007:f15] 宋Pro DM-i飞驰版夏日跨省自驾行（下） 8小时前 05:26 小米澎程N70 Max静态体验之外观+配置篇！ [e007:f16] 前天 21:00 53:32 全网最详细，小米澎程N90评测 前天 21:00 15:47 试驾雷克萨斯LX 700h 3.5TT混动有魄力 昨天 07:00 热门文章标签 评测体验 海选导购 新车资讯 用车攻略 二手车 改装车 自驾旅行 越野 文化历史 技术解析 车展 扫码下载汽车之家App © 2026 汽车之家 京公网安备 11010802000104号 京ICP备09113703号-1 信息网络传播视听节目许可证: 0110553 广播电视节目制作经营许可证 公司名称：北京车之家信息技术有限公司 中央网信办违法和不良信息举报中心 违法和不良信息举报电话：400-868-5856 举报邮箱：jubao@ 隐私协议 营业执照 2026/8/1 16:41:36。

evidence.title: F1マシンにおける熱電発電の50対50の比率を2027年に廃止するという基本合意が締結された。
evidence.body: [e003:f01] ゾエ・レダン＝ムレ 09年05月2026日12時00分に公開 コメント ©DPPI DPPI FIAは5月8日（金）、2027年からF1における内燃機関と電気系統間の動力配分を変更することについて、原則合意に達したと発表した。 [e003:f02] これは、今シーズン開始以来、現行のエンジン規定に対して寄せられてきた批判への直接的な対応である。 [e003:f03] 2026年シーズン開始以来、ほぼ全ての関係者が共有している見解は、熱エネルギーと電力の配分がほぼ均等（50対50に近い）になったことで、ドライビングの本質が大きく変化したというものだ。 [e003:f04] マイアミでF1マシンにはすでに調整が導入されており、ドライバーがフルスロットル時により多くのエネルギーを回収できるようにスーパークリッピングを250kW（335hp）から350kW（469hp）に引き上げ、予選で許容されるエネルギー量を8MJから7MJに削減した。 [e003:f05] 各方向で50kWの再調整 金曜日に合意された基本合意には、2つの対称的な変更が含まれている。 [e003:f06] 1つは、燃料流量の増加によって内燃機関の出力を約50kW増加させ、熱出力を約400kW（536馬力）にするというもの。 [e003:f07] その結果、内燃機関が60対40に近い出力配分となり、多くのドライバーやパドック関係者が問題視している現在の50対50の配分から脱却することになる。 [e003:f08] 燃料流量の増加は、パワーユニットのハードウェア変更を伴う可能性があり、まさにそのため、この措置は直ちに実施されるのではなく、2027年のF1マシンで検討されている。 [e003:f09] いわゆる「原則合意」は、パワーユニットメーカーによる投票、それに続くFIA世界モータースポーツ評議会による電子投票による承認という、通常のガバナンスプロセスを経る必要があります。 [e003:f10] しかし、FIAは、この合意が5月8日（金）の会議で「満場一致」で成立したと述べており、正式な承認が大きな障害となることはないだろうと示唆しています。 [e003:f11] FIAはまた、マイアミで導入された調整の評価は継続中であり、今後のラウンドに向けて、スタート時の安全性の見直しやウェットコンディションに特化した対策、5月22日から24日に開催されるカナダグランプリで予定されている視覚信号の改善など、さらなる変更の可能性を検討していると明記している。 [e003:f12] こちらもお読みください > FIAの第一歩は不十分だ：「F1にはさらなる変更が必要だ」 この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する F1 31/07/2026 15:41 メルセデスが波乱のハンガリーGPを分析 タグ: 2027 F1 規制 平等に読む F1 31/07/2026 11:02 トト・ヴォルフは、キミ・アントネッリがF2デビューする前からメルセデスと契約を結んでいた。 [e003:f13] 開発には莫大な資金が投入されたにもかかわらず、意思決定者たちは最後まで無能ぶりを露呈させ、F1が嘲笑の的となるまで、惨事が確定するまで対応を怠った。 [e003:f14] 内燃機関の効率を変更することで、燃料タンク、ひいてはシャシーに影響が出る可能性があります…一部のチームは2027年シーズンに向けてシャシーを維持する計画を立てていました！ [e003:f15] v ヴァンサン・モエ 11/05/26 付け加えておくと、この愚かな規制とその後の完全な方針転換によって無駄に費やされた時間、エネルギー、そして金銭は、権力に溺れ、破滅に向かっていると警告する者の声に耳を傾けようとしない指導者たちの傲慢さの結果に他ならない。 [e003:f16] :):):) A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 9/05/26 ついに…FIAとBSから2027年シーズンに向けた賢明な決定が…😎👀👍 H ヒルトン レオン 9/05/26 つまり、内燃機関は未来であり、電気自動車は過去のものだということだ！

evidence.title: Honda bullish about update for Aston Martin after F1 summer break
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Honda Racing chief Shintaro Orihara is optimistic about the remainder of Aston Martin's F1 season, issuing a positive update on their power unit. [e004:f02] Aston Martin brought 16 chassis upgrades to the Hungarian Grand Prix , with design legend Adrian Newey having worked tirelessly to try and develop the car since the start of 2026. [e004:f03] The Silverstone-based outfit had been squabbling with Cadillac on the back two rows of the grid for much of the 2026 season, struggling with both reliability and performance. [e004:f04] Article continues under video But the revised AMR26 that the team brought to the Hungaroring allowed them to take a step forward, with Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso finishing 13th and 14th respectively in the race, a day after Alonso made it into Q2 for the first time this season. [e004:f05] During the weekend, Newey revealed there would be more upgrades coming to the chassis at the Italian and Azerbaijan Grands Prix later in the summer, but before then, something arguably even more exciting is coming for Aston Martin. [e004:f06] The team have been struggling with their Honda power unit for most of this year so far, but following the summer break, Honda will be unveiling an upgraded power unit at the Dutch Grand Prix. [e004:f07] That is the next race on the calendar, and Honda's upgrades are in part thanks to the FIA's additional development upgrade and opportunities (ADUO) scheme. [e004:f08] ADUO was brought in at the start of the year to help struggling power unit manufacturers amid the 2026 regulations reset, offering more time to manufacturers who are lagging behind the best power unit. [e004:f09] Honda have the worst-performing power unit, and were given two homologations in the first round of ADUO rulings, with the second ADUO period coming up after race 12 (the Dutch GP on August 23). [e004:f10] Orihara has issued some very confident updates on both Honda and Aston Martin's progress as the team look to move up the constructors' championship standings. [e004:f11] "In Hungary, we saw some pretty strong pace and now we’re back in the mix," Orihara told AS . [e004:f12] "Any improvement is crucial to catching up with the rival car, and introducing the new engine at Zandvoort is essential.

evidence.title: F1 insider reveals Fernando Alonso's agreed 'five-year contract' but he has big decision to make
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Sky Sports F1 pundit David Croft has said that 45-year-old Fernando Alonso has got a five-year contract already in place at Aston Martin. [e005:f02] Alonso recently turned 45, and is currently deciding whether or not he wants to continue racing in F1 having had a disastrous start to the 2026 season, only picking up one championship point as his Aston Martin team have struggled with reliability and performance issues. [e005:f03] The Spaniard is a two-time world champion, but the most recent of those titles came all the way back in 2006, while he has not won a grand prix since the 2013 Spanish Grand Prix. [e005:f04] Article continues under video It's been thought for many years that Alonso - who made his debut in 2001 - is going to stick around until he manages to claim a 33rd career race victory, but in 2026 that has looked further away than ever. [e005:f05] While his contract as a full-time F1 driver is set to run out at the end of this season , Croft has claimed that he has a five-year deal agreed with Aston Martin, which includes several seasons as an ambassador with the team. [e005:f06] Alonso's fellow countryman Pedro de la Rosa holds an ambassadorial and advisor role with Aston Martin at the age of 55, and Croft has stated that Alonso may well take up a similar role when he stops racing. [e005:f07] Alonso has been linked with a move to Alpine for one final season of racing with the Enstone-based outfit with whom he claimed both of his championships with back in 2005 and 2006. [e005:f08] But Croft has suggested that any move away in a racing sense would also affect an off-track deal that he has place ready for when he retires. [e005:f09] "Fernando Alonso says, 'I have a contract,' because him and Franco Colapinto and Carlos were discussing or having this discussed in the press conference," Croft revealed on Sky Sports' F1 Show . [e005:f10] He's got a five-year contract as far as I understand it, of which two years was for driving, three years was for ambassador with Aston Martin, but the choice was Fernando’s as to whether he wanted to move to an ambassador role or carry on driving.

evidence.body: [e001:f01] Space Force contract for 18 Falcon 9 launches through 2027, marking the largest publicly announced batch of missions under the National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1 program. [e001:f02] The award covers launches from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California to deploy military satellites that detect, track, and communicate information about airborne threats in near real time. [e001:f03] The contract consists of two task orders supporting the Space Based Sensing and Targeting portfolio, a collection of satellite programs designed to improve how the military detects and tracks threats. [e001:f04] The launches must be completed by the end of 2027, requiring an average of roughly one mission per month from Vandenberg depending on satellite delivery schedules. [e001:f05] The Space Force achieved an unprecedented acquisition timeline for the award, completing the procurement in roughly two months from requirement identification to contract award, according to Col. [e001:f06] Eric Zarybnisky, the Space Force’s acting portfolio acquisition executive for space access. [e001:f07] This rapid pace reflects the military’s urgent demand for launch capacity to support next-generation satellite networks. [e001:f08] SpaceX’s dominance in military launch stems partly from its existing infrastructure and operational capability. [e001:f09] The company currently holds the only combination of launch frequency, operational Falcon 9 rockets, and West Coast infrastructure needed to support a campaign of this scale, according to SpaceNews. [e001:f11] The award follows the Space Force’s decision earlier in July 2026 to raise the Phase 3 Lane 1 contract ceiling from $5.6 billion to $17 billion, reflecting expectations that military launch demand will grow substantially faster than originally anticipated. [e001:f12] Seven companies currently hold positions on the Lane 1 contract vehicle, yet only SpaceX has demonstrated the operational capacity to execute large-scale national security launch campaigns at the required pace. [e001:f13] The Space Based Sensing and Targeting portfolio oversees multiple critical programs, including the Space Development Agency’s Tracking Layer—a constellation of infrared satellites designed to detect and track advanced missile threats—and the Space Data Network Backbone that moves large volumes of military data across the Joint Force using optical links between satellites. evidence.title: SpaceX launches Falcon 9 with classified spy satellite from Cape Canaveral
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The NROL-95 mission is scheduled for liftoff at 3:09 a.m. [e002:f02] ET from Space Launch Complex 40, with a 44-minute launch window opening at 2:37 a.m. [e002:f03] According to the NRO’s official launch page, the Falcon 9 will deploy the classified payload into orbit from the Florida facility. [e002:f04] Following deployment, the Falcon 9’s first-stage booster will attempt a recovery landing at Landing Zone 2 south of the launch pad. [e002:f05] This booster recovery will produce a sonic boom audible across central Florida, as the rocket descends through the atmosphere at supersonic speeds—a phenomenon that has become routine with SpaceX’s reusable rocket program. [e002:f06] The NROL-95 mission is part of the National Reconnaissance Office’s Proliferated Architecture program, a constellation of numerous smaller, cost-effective satellites deployed across multiple orbital planes. [e002:f07] This approach represents a shift from the agency’s traditional reliance on large, expensive satellites. [e002:f08] According to an NRO statement from April 2026, the proliferated architecture captured more than 400,000 collections in 2025 alone, demonstrating the effectiveness of the multi-satellite strategy for intelligence gathering. [e002:f09] SpaceX has become the primary launch provider for the NRO’s national security missions. [e002:f10] The NROL-105 mission in January 2026 was the first of approximately a dozen NRO launches scheduled throughout the year, consisting of both proliferated architecture and other national security payloads. [e002:f11] The company’s Falcon 9 rocket has proven reliable for these sensitive government missions, with the reusable first stage reducing launch costs and enabling more frequent deployments. [e002:f12] The NRO, a U.S. intelligence agency that operates spy satellites, has expanded its launch cadence significantly under the Proliferated Architecture initiative. [e002:f13] NROL-172, launched in May 2026, was the second proliferated launch of the year, followed by NROL-179 in June. evidence.title: Sonic boom rattles Central Florida after SpaceX Falcon 9 launch
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The rocket lifted off at 3:10 a.m. [e003:f02] EDT, carrying the NROL-95 mission, a classified national security payload for the National Reconnaissance Office. [e003:f03] The sonic boom occurred about eight minutes after liftoff, when the Falcon 9’s first-stage booster returned to Cape Canaveral Landing Zone 2. [e003:f04] This was the seventh flight for the reusable booster, which had previously supported launches including KF-01, IMAP, NROL-77, GPS III-9, CRS-34, and a Starlink mission. [e003:f05] A sonic boom is the thunder-like noise heard on the ground when an aircraft or aerospace vehicle travels faster than the speed of sound, according to NASA’s definition. [e003:f06] The sound occurs because the object creates shock waves as it breaks through the sound barrier, producing the distinctive loud report that residents often mistake for an explosion. [e003:f07] The intensity and range of sonic booms depend on atmospheric conditions. [e003:f08] Temperature, humidity, and wind all affect how far and how loudly those booms travel, meaning Central Florida residents are more likely to hear them during the region’s warm, muggy summers than during cooler, drier winter months. [e003:f09] Early-morning launches like this one can carry the sound across a wide area because cooler air near the ground acts as a better conductor of sound waves. [e003:f10] SpaceX regularly warns residents in advance of launches that may produce sonic booms. [e003:f11] The booster recovery is a critical part of the company’s reusability strategy, allowing the same first-stage booster to be refurbished and launched multiple times, reducing launch costs and increasing flight frequency. [e003:f12] The NROL-95 mission represents the continued partnership between SpaceX and the U.S. government for national security launches from Florida’s Space Coast. evidence.body: [e007:f01] 株式会社NTTドコモ（以下、ドコモ）とNTTドコモビジネス株式会社（以下、NTTドコモビジネス）は、2026年7月29日から熊本県や災害対応機関などに衛星ブロードバンドインターネットサービス「Starlink Business」やスマートフォン、タブレット端末などの無償提供を開始しています。 [e007:f02] Starlink Business設置中 「Starlink Business」 はアンテナが小型・軽量のため運びやすく、短時間での設置と Wi-Fi 環境構築が可能です。 [e007:f03] ドコモとNTTドコモビジネスは、熊本県と連携し、自治体や病院などの関係機関へ「Starlink Business」の設置を進めるとともに、スマートフォン、タブレット端末、衛星電話なども計500台を無償提供しています。 [e007:f04] これにより、被災された方や救援活動に従事される方々が、緊急時の情報収集や関係者への連絡を迅速に行えるよう支援します。 [e007:f05] このほか、ドコモから一般社団法人 情報支援レスキュー隊に対しても、両社間の「災害時における相互協力に関する協定」※にもとづき、スマートフォンやタブレット、ルーターを無償提供します。 [e007:f06] 今後もドコモおよびNTTドコモビジネスは、通信環境の整備にとどまらず、被災地や関係機関のニーズを踏まえながら、支援を継続してまいります。 [e007:f07] ※2026年3月11日に締結された協定の詳細は以下の報道発表を参照ください。 [e007:f08] https:// 報道発表資料に記載された情報は、発表日現在のものです。 [e007:f09] 仕様、サービス内容、お問い合わせ先などの内容は予告なしに変更されることがありますので、あらかじめご了承ください。
